title: Error Allowance by Return Reason - Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders
content:
On an error-return refund for Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders, an error allowance is paid according to the reason on the return authorization being settled - the latest authorization on the order in status received, by received date.

| Reason on the authorization settled | Error allowance |
|---|---|
| Wrong item | $3.00 |
| Not as described | $3.00 |
| Defective | $1.50 |
| Damaged | Nothing |

The allowance is a fixed dollar amount per settlement; it does not vary with the number of units received back.

### Points of judgement

- A wrong item (a different item was sent than the one ordered) and an item not as described (it differs from its listing, such as color, size or material) carry the same $3.00 allowance.
- A defective item (it does not work as it should) carries $1.50.
- A damaged item carries no allowance.
- The reason is the one recorded on the authorization being settled; an earlier authorization's reason on the same order plays no part here.

**Example (hypothetical).** Two units of a cat tree received back with reason not as described carry one $3.00 allowance; the same return with reason defective would carry $1.50.
